title: The rest of the API in the CLI
items: The CLI docs describe `whk alerts get` and `set`, `whk mock preview`, `whk layouts preview`, `whk send-email`, `whk requests download` (an email's exact message or one attachment, to the file `-o` names) and `whk requests replay` and `replay-range` (through the endpoint's layouts and destinations again)
The agent skill points agents at those commands instead of `whk api`
